See before you download — inline image & PDF preview.

## Added

- **Inline preview for images and PDFs.** On the download page, image and PDF
  shares now show a preview before you download — the decrypted file is streamed
  inline (`?inline=1`) without counting as a download. To keep the download limit
  honest, the preview is offered only for shares **without** a download limit
  (so it can never bypass the limit) and **without** a password. Everything else
  downloads as before.
